install: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Linux" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.bashrc" ]; then sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" || true; fi; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; rustup component add rustfmt clippy llvm-tools-preview; if ! command -v cargo-llvm-cov >/dev/null 2>&1; then os="$(uname -s)"; arch="$(uname -m)"; case "$os-$arch" in Linux-x86_64) target="x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu" ;; Linux-aarch64|Linux-arm64) target="aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu" ;; Darwin-arm64) target="aarch64-apple-darwin" ;; Darwin-x86_64) target="x86_64-apple-darwin" ;; *) target="" ;; esac; if [ -n "$target" ]; then curl -fsSL "https://github.com/taiki-e/cargo-llvm-cov/releases/latest/download/cargo-llvm-cov-${target}.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C "$HOME/.local/bin"; fi; fi; cargo fetch --manifest-path rust-core/Cargo.toml --locked; if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then git config core.hooksPath .githooks; fi
